t: This is 115 to 121 Tooley Street in Southwark, a Grade II listed building also known as Aston Webb House. It was the General Office of Boord and Son's Distillery, built between 1899 and 1901, and has since been converted. It was designed by Aston Webb, the architect behind the principal façade of Buckingham Palace and the main building of the Victoria and Albert Museum. Webb was also president of the Royal Academy from 1919 to 1924.
